name: Sasaki Kyougo
source:
The principal of a school and the mayor of a city, as well as a politician. As an educator, he hopes that men can give up meaningless hatred, otherwise they will become "pathetic ghosts" and his Kasuga fighters will have to hunt them down.

[spoiler][url=/c5143]Mochizuki "Shirokuma" Takara[/url]'s maternal grandfather.[/spoiler]
